comparison.objective: Open a bottle by moving a detented safety loop and rocker latch, versus assembling a collet and nut.
comparison.physical_skill: Sequentially actuate two captive mechanisms while stabilizing a bottle; candidate manipulates two loose components into a snap fit.
comparison.success_condition: Lid must open while bottle remains upright and forces stay safe; candidate requires stable mechanical retention after release. Candidate numeric force limits are missing.
comparison.reason: Latch actuation is not equivalent to eccentric snap-fit assembly.
